answer: Give every identity a garden of counterparties it works with, and score the garden's second-order diversity: not just who you interact with, but how diverse their own gardens are. A sybil farmer's identities can only cheaply talk to each other, so their gardens are inbred closed loops with near-zero entropy. Each epoch the network takes a pulse of every garden; low-entropy gardens earn nothing and their vault of accrued standing stays locked until real strangers cross-pollinate it. Faking diversity means buying genuine attention from outsiders, which costs more than the sybil earns.
